# Kawaro documentation (English)

# Quick start

1. [Install](install.md) Kawaro.
2. Select one or more files in your file manager.
3. Right click and choose **Kawaro**. The hive opens.
4. Click a cell. The result is saved next to the original, which is never changed.

Progress shows in the tray tooltip. Only actions that fit your files, and the tools you have installed, appear.

Next: [Use the hive](use.md) and [Formats](formats.md).

---

# Install

## Windows 10 and 11 (64 bit)

Download the MSI. It installs for your user and needs no administrator rights. A portable ZIP is also available. The build is unsigned, so [SmartScreen warns you](site:windows).

## Linux (64 bit)

Download the DEB for Ubuntu and Debian, or the RPM for Fedora. Nautilus needs the `nautilus-python` package.

## Verify

Check every download against `SHA256SUMS`. The steps are on the [download page](site:download#verify).

## Extra tools

Video and audio need FFmpeg. Documents and PDF need LibreOffice and Ghostscript. An action whose tool is missing does not appear in the hive. Run `kawaro doctor` to see what was found.

## From source (Linux)

```
git clone https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro
cd kawaro
./scripts/install.sh
```

Needs Rust 1.85 or newer. To remove it: `./scripts/uninstall.sh`.

---

# Use the hive

- **Open it:** select files, right click, choose Kawaro. On Linux you can also hold the drop shortcut while dragging ([shortcuts](shortcuts.md)).
- **Read it:** the centre cell shows the full name of the cell under your pointer.
- **Pick:** click a cell. Cells that do not fit your selection are not drawn.
- **Result:** saved next to the original under a new name, or in a subfolder if you change `output` in [settings](settings.md).
- **Progress:** in the tray tooltip. On Windows, the tray menu has Cancel all.
- **Many files:** actions that combine files, such as merging PDFs, appear when you select two or more.

On Hyprland you can bind Super plus right click to open the hive. See the [Hyprland guide](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro/blob/main/integrations/linux/hyprland/README.md).

---

# How it works

One service shows the interface. A thin command line client asks it to open the hive.

![From right click to result](diagram:flow)

## The pieces

![Processes and crates](diagram:overview)

- `kawarod` holds the hive, the queue, the tray and the engines.
- FFmpeg, LibreOffice and Ghostscript run as separate processes, killed with their whole tree on cancel.
- The original file is never changed: the result is written to a temporary file and then renamed.

## Add a format

![TOML plus an adapter](diagram:extend)

## Where the hive is drawn

![Layer path or window path](diagram:surface)

## Updates

![Signed updates](diagram:updates)

What the hive does for each kind of file. An action whose tool is missing does not appear.

| Combine into one PDF | built in |  |
| Convert to ICO | built in |  |
| Resize to 50% | built in |  |
| Fit to 1920 px | built in |  |
| Rotate 90° | built in |  |
| Flip horizontally | built in |  |
| Grayscale | built in |  |
| Compress | built in |  |
| Remove metadata | built in |  |
| Convert to GIF | built in |  |
| Convert to TIFF | built in |  |
| Convert to BMP | built in |  |

# Shortcuts

## Linux: the drop shortcut

Hold **Super+Z** while dragging files and the hive appears. Let go and it closes. A short tap shows nothing.

- GNOME 48 and later, KDE 6: Kawaro registers the shortcut through the desktop portal. The first time, the desktop asks you to allow it.
- Older desktops and Hyprland: bind `kawaro drop` yourself. The steps are in the [full guide](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro/blob/main/docs/drop-shortcut.md).
- Change the hold time with `hold_ms` in [settings](settings.md).

## Windows

Drag a file with the right mouse button and the hive opens during the drag, at the dragged file. Drop it on the cell of the action you want. No key is held while you drag, so Explorer keeps its own drag behavior: a drop outside the hive copies, moves or creates shortcuts as it always does, and the original file is never touched. A short right click shows nothing.

---

# Settings

The file is `config.toml`: `~/.config/kawaro/` on Linux, `%APPDATA%\Kawaro\` on Windows. Every key is optional, unknown keys are ignored, and a broken file falls back to the defaults.

| Key | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | `auto`, `ar`, `en` | `auto` |
| `theme` | `auto`, `light`, `dark` | `auto` |
| `output` | `beside`, `subfolder` | `beside` |
| `output_folder` | folder name for `subfolder` | `Kawaro` |
| `quality` | `light`, `balanced`, `max` | `balanced` |
| `open_folder_when_done` | `true`, `false` | `false` |
| `notify` | `true`, `false` | `true` |
| `hive_surface` | `auto`, `layer`, `window` | `auto` |
| `hold_ms` | 100 to 2000 | `400` |
| `portal_shortcut` | `true`, `false` | `true` |
| `shortcut` | Windows hotkey, the internal escape hatch only; holding it during a drag changes what Explorer does with the drag | `Ctrl+Alt+H` |
| `drop_key` | the drag key chosen in Settings | the right-button drag on Windows, `Alt` on Linux |
| `update_check` | `true`, `false` | `true` |
| `update_channel` | `stable`, `beta` | `stable` (`beta` in a beta build) |
| `update_mode` | `ask`, `auto` | `ask` |

---

# Troubleshooting

- **An action is missing:** its tool is not installed. Run `kawaro doctor`.
- **Windows warns "Windows protected your PC":** the build is unsigned. [Verify the file](site:download#verify), then choose More info and Run anyway.
- **The hive opens without keyboard focus (GNOME, KDE):** focus tests on real desktops are not finished. Report it with your desktop and version.
- **Nothing happens on right click:** run `kawaro ping`. If the service does not answer, run `kawaro daemon` and try again.
- **Updates:** set `update_check = false` to stop the daily check ([settings](settings.md)).

Report a problem on [GitHub](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro/issues).

---

# Contribute

- Add a format: one TOML file in `actions/` plus a small adapter in `crates/engines/`. No action logic in the UI.
- Never modify the original file. Engines write a temporary file, and the queue renames it.
- Every user string in Arabic and English, with right to left layout.
- Colours, sizes and durations come from `design/tokens.json`.
- Read [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and open an issue before a large change.

The code is GPL-3.0-or-later: [github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/kawaro).

---
